claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.Process_MoveToDestination (0x0600509E) and its direct Boolean helper Referee.IsReachedDestination (0x0600508B) are exact method bodies. Process_MoveToDestination is a parameterless instance method with an exact 89-byte body: it returns unless Referee.State is raw 8, then writes PlPos.x = PlPos.x + MoveVel.x and PlPos.y = PlPos.y + MoveVel.y. It calls IsReachedDestination(); when that result is true it calls Referee.Process_ArrivedDestination(), then returns. IsReachedDestination is a parameterless instance Boolean method with an exact 68-byte body. It forms local delta = DestPos - implicit(PlPos), computes Vector2.Dot(delta,MoveVel), and uses bgt.un against raw Float32 0.0f. An ordered dot <= 0 returns true immediately; a greater or unordered dot continues to the second test. That test loads delta.magnitude and uses bgt.un against raw Float32 bits 0x3D7FFFFF (0.0624999962747097f); an ordered magnitude <= that value returns true, while greater or unordered returns false. FACT-0074 pins Process_MoveToDestination at UpdateReferee IL+0x0062.
